workers.measurement: Release artifacts from unchanged build scripts, SIMD features, and canonical Wrangler configurations. Gzip level 9. Wasm totals exclude the separately listed JavaScript wrappers.
workers.startupProfileLimit: Each local CPU profile is one instrumented sample. Profile windows differ from deployed startup time and establish no startup improvement.

browser.bundleMetricAccounting: Static/reachable JS closures and selected worker/WASM inventory are separate. Inventory totals include aliases and are not observed downloads. Identical WASM bytes at different URLs may still be fetched separately.
browser.bundleMetricLimit: Both runs serve the same 891-file frontend snapshot. Rebuilt browser Wasm matches that snapshot exactly. These results isolate this Rust cleanup and exclude the independent locale change.
browser.timingLimit: One local sample per operation. UI confirmation, automation, background refill, and intentional waits affect the results. This evidence establishes no wallet latency improvement.

sourceMetrics.accounting: The bloat report excludes comments and blanks from code-line counts. Exact-repeat counts depend on line formatting. The metric grew by 49 meaningful lines after structural formatting. All four moved bodies match after scope and formatting normalization. No bloat baseline was reset.

command: a linked device links a third device, which signs NEAR and Tempo and exports both keys

preservedInvariants: The Signing Worker entrypoint retains its wallet Durable Object claim-and-consume transaction and terminal-response persistence. The deleted D1 helper served the excluded non-Signing-Worker fallback.
Linked-device and rotatable-lane material readers remain live. The additional three-device E2E verifies NEAR and Tempo signing, both key exports, and continued signing on earlier devices.
Restore-record row conversion still calls record.validate and checks installation evidence. Deleted timestamp getters and unused constructors do not remove stored fields or row validation.
Authorized-cleanup failure receipt bytes remain in durable rows and lower-level replay decisions. The removed higher-level Vec copy had no consumer.
The CLI retains the same response fields, Serde names, types, defaults, and unknown-field policy. Field renaming does not remove accepted wire data.
Role feature conditions preserve every class required by the default, staging, and production-testnet bindings and migrations.
deletionReReview.limits: Previously recorded missing Google credentials and private-harness routing fixture failures remain. The temporary-harness concurrent 503 result still lacks a baseline control. No source restoration follows from those unverified cases.
